author: Astral

limits.fixtureManifest: LOCAL-OFFLINE-CHECK URL and zero commit; local parser fixture only, never a submission manifest

productionSourceHashMethod: SHA-256 of src/main paths sorted with Windows path ordering (forward slashes) + NUL + LF-normalized contents + NUL

supplies.bottomlessBucket: filled-presence-only; type and charges checked manually

checklistDisplay.layout: compact quantity-first rows with item sprites

inventoryPlanning.itemFlags: public RuneLite ItemComposition.isStackable and getLinkedNoteId; client thread
inventoryPlanning.planner: fewest contiguous loads, then relative bank detour cost; prepared patch order preserved
inventoryPlanning.bankChoice: saved per preset; custom instructions supported
inventoryPlanning.notedProtection: enabled by default; notes required for noteable nonstacking payments
inventoryPlanning.filterRefresh: current inventory only; patch progress preserved
inventoryPlanning.bankCompletion: manual, local, plan-fingerprinted; excluded from backups

teleportHighlights.settingScope: global native cog; excluded from preset backups
teleportHighlights.rendering: public WidgetItemOverlay and ItemManager.getItemOutline; green sprite outline only
teleportHighlights.target: next unfinished patch or unacknowledged bank stop
teleportHighlights.itemForms: explicit usable IDs; excludes empty, noted and placeholder forms
